set -u
mkdir -p /daodan/state/tools/bin "$HOME"
{ tar -xzf /daodan/state/in/node.tar.gz -C /daodan/state/tools && mv /daodan/state/tools/node-v24.22.3-linux-x64 /daodan/state/tools/node ; } >&2 || echo 'DAODAN-MISSING node@24.22.3' >&2
chmod 755 /daodan/state/in/mise
{ MISE_DATA_DIR=/daodan/state/tools/mise MISE_YES=1 /daodan/state/in/mise install node@20 >&2 && for d in $(MISE_DATA_DIR=/daodan/state/tools/mise MISE_YES=1 /daodan/state/in/mise bin-paths node@20); do for b in "$d"/*; do n=${b##*/}; printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec env MISE_DATA_DIR=/daodan/state/tools/mise MISE_YES=1 /daodan/state/in/mise x node@20 -- %s "$@"\n' "$n" > /daodan/state/tools/bin/$n && chmod 755 /daodan/state/tools/bin/$n; done; done; } || echo 'DAODAN-MISSING node@20' >&2
{ npm install -g --prefix /daodan/state/tools/npm --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error playwright-core@1.64.1 ; } >&2
for f in /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ubuntu.sources; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then sed -i "s|http://|https://|g" "$f"; fi
done
node /daodan/state/tools/npm/lib/node_modules/playwright-core/cli.js install --with-deps --only-shell chromium >&2
cd /work || exit 70
exit 0

set -u
mkdir -p /daodan/out
export DAODAN_PLAYWRIGHT=/daodan/state/tools/npm/lib/node_modules/playwright-core
s=$(date +%s); c=0
if [ "$c" = 0 ]; then
  timeout -k 30 1050 node /daodan/state/in/explore.cjs /daodan/out 0 /work/react-app - 90 'npm run dev' '[]' > /daodan/out/driver-0.log 2>&1
  echo "DAODAN-APP 0 exit $? $(( $(date +%s) - s ))"
fi
exit 0

set -u
mkdir -p /daodan/state/tools/bin /daodan/state/home /daodan/state/venvs
{ mkdir -p /daodan/state/tools/uvc /daodan/state/tools/bin && tar -xzf /daodan/state/in/uv.tar.gz -C /daodan/state/tools/uvc && ln -sf /daodan/state/tools/uvc/*/uv /daodan/state/tools/bin/uv ; } >&2 || echo 'DAODAN-MISSING uv@0.11.28' >&2
export UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=never UV_NO_PROGRESS=1
export UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=never UV_NO_PROGRESS=1; for f in 'functions-python'; do ( cd "$f" && r=requirements.txt; [ -f $r ] || r=pyproject.toml; uv venv -q --python python3 "/daodan/state/venvs/$f" && uv pip install -q --python "/daodan/state/venvs/$f" -r "$r" ) > /tmp/daodan-restore.log 2>&1 || if [ -s /daodan/state/without-vcs.txt ]; then mv /tmp/daodan-restore.log /tmp/daodan-restore.log.vcs; ( cd "$f" && r=requirements.txt; [ -f $r ] || r=pyproject.toml; uv pip install -q --python "/daodan/state/venvs/$f" -r "$r" --overrides /daodan/state/without-vcs.txt ) > /tmp/daodan-restore.log 2>&1 && { printf 'DAODAN-VCS-FAILED pip %s\n' "$f"; { grep -E '^error|No solution|not found|^ *[×│├╰]|^ *Caused by' /tmp/daodan-restore.log.vcs || tail -n 30 /tmp/daodan-restore.log.vcs; } | head -n 30; echo DAODAN-VCS-END; } >&2 || { cat /tmp/daodan-restore.log >> /tmp/daodan-restore.log.vcs; { printf 'DAODAN-RESTORE-FAILED pip %s\n' "$f"; { grep -E '^error|No solution|not found|^ *[×│├╰]|^ *Caused by' /tmp/daodan-restore.log.vcs || tail -n 30 /tmp/daodan-restore.log.vcs; } | head -n 30; echo DAODAN-RESTORE-END; } >&2; }; else { printf 'DAODAN-RESTORE-FAILED pip %s\n' "$f"; { grep -E '^error|No solution|not found|^ *[×│├╰]|^ *Caused by' /tmp/daodan-restore.log || tail -n 30 /tmp/daodan-restore.log; } | head -n 30; echo DAODAN-RESTORE-END; } >&2; fi; done; true
( cd /work/functions-python && uv pip install -q --python /daodan/state/venvs/functions-python/bin/python --group dev ) > /tmp/daodan-deps.log 2>&1 || { echo 'DAODAN-DYNAMIC 0 deps-failed'; tail -n 8 /tmp/daodan-deps.log; echo DAODAN-DYNAMIC-END; } >&2
/daodan/state/venvs/functions-python/bin/python -c 'import pytest' 2>/dev/null || { uv pip install -q --python /daodan/state/venvs/functions-python/bin/python pytest==9.1.1 >&2 && echo 'DAODAN-DYNAMIC 0 brought pytest 9.1.1' >&2; }
exit 0

set -u
mkdir -p /daodan/out
/usr/local/bin/python3 /daodan/state/in/python_record.py site /daodan/site || exit 70
run() {
  n=$1; folder=$2; py=$3; shift 3
  [ -x "$py" ] || { echo "DAODAN-DYNAMIC $n no-python"; return; }
  echo "DAODAN-DYNAMIC $n python $("$py" -c 'import sys; print("%d.%d.%d" % sys.version_info[:3], int(hasattr(sys, "monitoring")))')"
  "$py" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(not hasattr(sys, "monitoring"))' || return
  start=$(date +%s)
  ( cd "/work/$folder" && exec env PYTHONPATH=/daodan/site DYN_ROOT=/work DYN_OUT=/daodan/out/observed-$n-%p.json timeout -s INT -k 30 3600 "$py" "$@" ) > /daodan/out/tests-$n.log 2>&1
  echo "DAODAN-DYNAMIC $n exit $? $(( $(date +%s) - start ))"
}
run 0 functions-python /daodan/state/venvs/functions-python/bin/python -m pytest --continue-on-collection-errors
exit 0

find /work -type f \( -iname .env -o -iname '.env.*' \) | while IFS= read -r f; do REL="${f#/work/}" awk 'function hex(s, out, i) { out = ""; for (i = 1; i <= length(s); i++) out = out sprintf("%02x", ord[substr(s, i, 1)]); return out } BEGIN { for (i = 1; i < 256; i++) ord[sprintf("%c", i)] = i; file = hex(ENVIRON["REL"]) } /^[ \t]*(#.*)?$/ { print; next } match($0, /^[ \t]*(export[ \t]+)?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*[ \t]*=/) { head = substr($0, 1, RLENGTH); name = head; sub(/^[ \t]*(export[ \t]+)?/, "", name); sub(/[ \t]*=$/, "", name); print head "./daodan-dotenv-" file "-" hex(name) }' "$f" > "$f.daodan" && mv -f "$f.daodan" "$f"; done

mkdir -p /daodan/state/results/1; (cd /work/react-app/src-tauri && exec env PATH=/daodan/state/tools/bin:/daodan/state/tools/node/bin:/daodan/state/tools/npm/bin:/daodan/state/tools/go/bin:/daodan/state/tools/rust/bin:/daodan/state/tools/cmake/bin:/opt/java/openjdk/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin HOME=/daodan/state/home GOPATH=/daodan/state/go GOCACHE=/daodan/state/go-build GOTELEMETRY=off CARGO_HOME=/daodan/state/cargo UV_CACHE_DIR=/daodan/state/uv npm_config_cache=/daodan/state/npm-cache npm_config_update_notifier=false VCPKG_ROOT=/daodan/state/tools/vcpkg VCPKG_DISABLE_METRICS=1 VCPKG_BINARY_SOURCES=clear CONAN_HOME=/daodan/state/conan-home CARGO_TERM_COLOR=never RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.99.1 RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 cargo metadata --format-version 1 --locked) > /daodan/state/results/1/stdout 2> /daodan/state/results/1/stderr; echo $? > /daodan/state/results/1/code
exit 0
